checkstyle.cost: runs the repo's own Gradle or Maven build

dependency-currency.cost: asks the npm registry over the network

go-test-coverage.cost: runs the repo's Go tests twice with coverage

go-vet.cost: compiles every Go package for go vet

java-test.cost: runs the repo's Java tests through its build

gofmt.cost: starts gofmt on every Go file

issue-link-once.cost: asks GitHub for the branch's pull request

local-branch.cost: asks GitHub for the branch's pull request and issues

spotless.cost: runs the repo's own Gradle or Maven build

workflow-ref-exists.cost: asks GitHub whether each workflow path exists

vitest-coverage-full.cost: runs the repo's Vitest suite with coverage
